name: teamhood
description: Find, plan and update your Teamhood work from ChatGPT.

interface.longDescription:
Teamhood is project management software with Kanban, Gantt and timesheets. It is made for organizations that run many projects with the same people. Learn more at https://teamhood.com.

With this connector, ChatGPT works in your Teamhood organization as you. Ask what is overdue, what changed this week or what a colleague is working on. Paste a task list from meeting notes and ChatGPT creates the project and its tasks, up to 100 per request. ChatGPT can also change status, dates and assignees, link dependencies, post comments, log time, and read an item’s history and attached images. Before you assign work, ChatGPT can check each person’s working hours, time off and planned hours.

ChatGPT has the same access as your Teamhood role. Each change shows at once, under your name with an AI label. Deleted items stay in the trash for 30 days. A read-only connection is available. ChatGPT cannot change roles, views, automations or organization settings.
capabilities: Check capacity, time off and planned hours
Set up item types, fields, teams and invitations
defaultPrompt: What's assigned to me that isn't done yet?
What changed on my projects this week?
Add a task due next Friday to one of my projects and assign it to me.

positive.description: Find the signed-in person's open work
positive.prompt: What's assigned to me in Teamhood that isn't done yet?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the test account's open items with their display ids, statuses and due dates, leaving out items that are done.

positive.description: Create a task under a project
positive.prompt: In Teamhood, add a task 'Prepare launch announcement' under the Warehouse Extension project, due next Friday, assigned to me.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates the task under Warehouse Extension with that due date and the test account as assignee, and answers with its display id. The task shows in Teamhood straight away.

positive.description: Change an item's status and comment on it
positive.prompt: Mark 'Steel delivery delay' as done in Teamhood and comment that the client approved it.
positive.expected_behavior: Sets the item's status to Done and posts the comment on it. Both show on the item in Teamhood.

positive.prompt: Log 2 hours on 'Fire-rating approval delay' in Teamhood for today.
positive.expected_behavior: Records a 2-hour time log on the item, dated today, for the test account.

positive.prompt: What has changed on 'Steel delivery delay' in Teamhood, and who made the changes?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the item's recorded changes, newest first, such as its creation and status changes, with who made each and when.

negative.description: A request Teamhood has nothing to do with
negative.prompt: Book me a flight to Vilnius for next Tuesday.
negative.expected_behavior: ChatGPT answers without calling any Teamhood tool.

negative.prompt: Delete everything in my Teamhood organization.
negative.expected_behavior: Nothing is deleted. ChatGPT asks which items are meant and waits for the user to confirm, as Teamhood's server instructions require before any deletion.

negative.prompt: Add five more seats to our Teamhood subscription.
negative.expected_behavior: No tool is called. ChatGPT explains that it cannot change the subscription and that an administrator manages it in Teamhood's settings.

review.commerce_description: Teamhood sells nothing through ChatGPT. The plugin works with an existing Teamhood account.

publication.release_notes: First release: find, create and update items, comments, time logs and dependencies; read attachments, capacity, time off and planned hours; search the help center; set up item types, fields, teams and invitations.
